website/components/media/expanded/genie-gpu.ts

WebGPU/Rust backend for the expand-modal genie warp —
Sourcesrc/website/components/media/expanded/genie-gpu.ts
UX surfaceBoot surfaces: what the user sees first on each bundle.

Members

(module scope)

The crate's wasm-bindgen surface — mirrors rust/genie/src/lib.rs. Method calls on a worker-routed handle are fire-and-forget postMessages (transferables move zero-copy); in-page mounts call the widget directly. Either way the contract is synchronous-looking.

set_rects

Pushes the warp rect pair — viewport CSS px. Always (modal rect, figure rect) regardless of direction.

  • @param fx @param fy @param fw @param fh The modal rect.
  • @param tx @param ty @param tw @param th The figure rect.

set_flags

Pushes the field flags — direction + which edge faces the figure.

  • @param opening 1 while opening, 0 on the collapse.
  • @param nearBottom 1 when the figure sits below the modal.

set_tint

Pushes the accent rgba 0-1 — the untextured ghost fill reads it.

  • @param r @param g @param b @param a Rgba channels.

set_progress

Pushes the eased funnel progress — the driver owns the clock.

  • @param p Funnel progress 0..1 (0 = modal sheet, 1 = figure funnel).

upload_bitmap

Uploads the decoded media frame — callable repeatedly (the thumb lands first, the full-res upgrade follows when it decodes).

  • @param bitmap The decoded frame — transferred on the worker route.
  • @param w Frame width px.
  • @param h Frame height px.

frame

One render tick — the crate repacks uniforms and draws the mesh.

  • @param dt Frame delta seconds.
  • @returns False when the surface is stale/lost.

uploadMediaTexture

Decodes the media in the wasm worker pool and uploads the bitmap to the crate — fire-and-forget: until the texture lands the shader draws the accent-tinted ghost, so a slow decode never stalls the warp. Thumb first (page-cached, decodes in a frame or two); the full-res source follows as an upgrade.

  • @param w The crate handle.
  • @param el The element — thumb/source/dimensions.

uploadSheetTexture

Uploads the composited modal sheet as the warp texture — the whole surface (glass panel + chrome text + media figure) funnels into the figure, matching the 2D backend. createImageBitmap on the baked canvas is a GPU-side copy (cheap, fire-and-forget); a missing/uneven bake or a rejected raster falls back to the media-file upload.

  • @param w The crate handle.
  • @param el The element — media fallback source.
  • @param sheet The composited sheet from buildGenieSheet.

mountGenieGpu

Attempts the WebGPU/Rust genie backend on the overlay canvas. MANUAL drive — the genie driver's own eased clock owns frame(dt) pacing so both backends render identical progress sequences.

  • @param canvas The overlay canvas (device-px sized by the driver).
  • @param el The element — media source/dimensions.
  • @param from Origin rect, viewport CSS px.
  • @param to Destination rect, viewport CSS px.
  • @param opening True on open, false on the collapse.
  • @param sheet The composited modal sheet — uploaded as the warp
  • @returns The renderer wrapping the widget handle, or null on any
